title: 数据高效语言建模：从前沿推进到原则引导的模型改进
summary: Qiushi Engine在BabyLM 2026 Strict-Small上开展长周期自主研究，通过三阶段（前沿推进、原则发现、原则引导改进）实现数据高效语言建模，发现围绕预测所需上下文依赖组织经验的学习原则，最终将Overall指标从42.02提升至42.25，并公开模型与代码。
summary_en: Qiushi Engine conducted a long-horizon autonomous research program on BabyLM 2026 Strict-Small, spanning frontier advancement, principle discovery, and principle-guided improvement. It found a testable data-efficient learning principle: organize experience around contextual dependencies needed for prediction. Overall rose from 42.02 to 42.25, achieving the top public Strict-Small result. Models and code are released.
